name: Monocular Normal Regularization
definition: Supervising predicted normals using smooth normal estimates from a pretrained monocular network (Omnidata) instead of gradients of rendered depths, which are noisy.
summary: Monocular Normal Regularization is a geometric loss function that supervises volume rendering optimization using smooth normal estimates from a pretrained monocular network, distinguishing itself from gradient-based methods by relying on external cues rather than noisy rendered depth gradients.
